verses.original: Πᾶσα ψυχὴ ὑποτασσέσθω ἐξουσίαις ὑπερεχούσαις γὰρ ἔστιν οὐ ἐξουσία εἰ μὴ ὑπὸ Θεοῦ δὲ αἱ οὖσαι εἰσίν τεταγμέναι ὑπὸ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Pasa psychē hypotassesthō exousiais hyperechousais gar estin ou exousia ei mē hypo Theou de hai ousai eisin tetagmenai hypo Theou
verses.literal: Everyone . . . must submit himself to the governing authorities . . . for there is no authority except . . . [that which is from] God - [The authorities] that exist . . . have been appointed by God

verses.original: ὥστε ὁ ἀντιτασσόμενος τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ ἀνθέστηκεν τῇ τοῦ Θεοῦ διαταγῇ δὲ οἱ ἀνθεστηκότες λήμψονται κρίμα ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: hōste ho antitassomenos tē exousia anthestēken tē tou Theou diatagē de hoi anthestēkotes lēmpsontai krima heautois
verses.literal: Consequently whoever resists - authority is opposing what - God has set in place and those who [do so] will bring judgment on themselves

verses.original: γὰρ οἱ ἄρχοντες εἰσὶν οὐκ φόβος τῷ ἀγαθῷ ἔργῳ ἀλλὰ τῷ κακῷ δὲ θέλεις μὴ φοβεῖσθαι τὴν ἐξουσίαν ποίει τὸ ἀγαθὸν καὶ ἕξεις ἐξ αὐτῆς ἔπαινον
verses.transliteration: gar hoi archontes eisin ouk phobos tō agathō ergō alla tō kakō de theleis mē phobeisthai tēn exousian poiei to agathon kai hexeis ex autēs epainon
verses.literal: For - rulers are not a terror - to good conduct but - to bad - Do you want vvv to be unafraid of the one in authority [Then] do what [is] right and you will have vvv his approval

verses.original: γὰρ ἐστιν Θεοῦ διάκονός εἰς σοὶ τὸ ἀγαθόν δὲ ἐὰν ποιῇς τὸ κακὸν φοβοῦ γὰρ οὐ φορεῖ τὴν μάχαιραν εἰκῇ γὰρ ἐστιν Θεοῦ διάκονός ἔκδικος εἰς ὀργὴν τῷ τὸ πράσσοντι κακὸν
verses.transliteration: gar estin Theou diakonos eis soi to agathon de ean poiēs to kakon phobou gar ou phorei tēn machairan eikē gar estin Theou diakonos ekdikos eis orgēn tō to prassonti kakon
verses.literal: For he is God’s servant for your - good But if you do - wrong be afraid for vvv he does not carry the sword in vain - He is God’s servant an agent of retribution to the vvv vvv wrongdoer

verses.original: Διὸ ἀνάγκη ὑποτάσσεσθαι οὐ μόνον διὰ τὴν ὀργὴν ἀλλὰ καὶ διὰ τὴν συνείδησιν
verses.transliteration: Dio anankē hypotassesthai ou monon dia tēn orgēn alla kai dia tēn syneidēsin
verses.literal: Therefore [it is] necessary to submit [ to authority ] not only to avoid - punishment but also as a matter of - conscience

verses.original: γὰρ διὰ τοῦτο καὶ τελεῖτε φόρους γὰρ εἰσιν Θεοῦ λειτουργοὶ προσκαρτεροῦντες εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο
verses.transliteration: gar dia touto kai teleite phorous gar eisin Theou leitourgoi proskarterountes eis auto touto
verses.literal: - This is also why . . . . . . you pay taxes For [the authorities] are God’s servants who devote themselves to vvv [their work]

verses.original: ἀπόδοτε πᾶσιν τὰς ὀφειλάς τὸν φόρον τῷ τὸν φόρον τὸ τέλος τῷ τὸ τέλος τὸν φόβον τῷ τὸν φόβον τὴν τιμήν τῷ τὴν τιμὴν
verses.transliteration: apodote pasin tas opheilas ton phoron tō ton phoron to telos tō to telos ton phobon tō ton phobon tēn timēn tō tēn timēn
verses.literal: Pay everyone what you owe [him] - taxes to whom - taxes [are due] - revenue to whom - revenue [is due] - respect to whom - respect [is due] - honor to whom - honor [is due]

verses.original: ὀφείλετε Μηδενὶ μηδὲν εἰ μὴ τὸ ἀλλήλους ἀγαπᾶν γὰρ ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἕτερον πεπλήρωκεν νόμον
verses.transliteration: opheilete Mēdeni mēden ei mē to allēlous agapan gar ho agapōn ton heteron peplērōken nomon
verses.literal: Be indebted to no one . . . except . . . - to one another [in] love For he who loves [his] neighbor has fulfilled [the] law

verses.original: γάρ τὸ Οὐ μοιχεύσεις Οὐ φονεύσεις Οὐ κλέψεις Οὐκ ἐπιθυμήσεις καὶ εἴ τις ἑτέρα ἐντολή ἀνακεφαλαιοῦται ἐν τούτῳ τῷ λόγῳ ἐν τῷ Ἀγαπήσεις σου τὸν πλησίον ὡς σεαυτόν
verses.transliteration: gar to Ou moicheuseis Ou phoneuseis Ou klepseis Ouk epithymēseis kai ei tis hetera entolē anakephalaioutai en toutō tō logō en tō Agapēseis sou ton plēsion hōs seauton
verses.literal: - The [commandments] vvv Do not commit adultery vvv Do not murder vvv Do not steal vvv Do not covet and - any other commandments are summed up in this [one] decree - - Love your - neighbor as yourself

verses.original: ἡ ἀγάπη οὐκ ἐργάζεται κακὸν τῷ πλησίον οὖν ἡ ἀγάπη πλήρωμα νόμου
verses.transliteration: hē agapē ouk ergazetai kakon tō plēsion oun hē agapē plērōma nomou
verses.literal: - Love vvv vvv does no wrong to [its] neighbor Therefore - love [is] [the] fulfillment of [the] law

verses.original: Καὶ τοῦτο εἰδότες τὸν καιρόν ὥρα ὅτι ἤδη ὑμᾶς ἐγερθῆναι ἐξ ὕπνου γὰρ ἡμῶν ἡ σωτηρία ἐγγύτερον νῦν ἢ ὅτε ἐπιστεύσαμεν
verses.transliteration: Kai touto eidotes ton kairon hōra hoti ēdē hymas egerthēnai ex hypnou gar hēmōn hē sōtēria engyteron nyn ē hote episteusamen
verses.literal: And [do] this understanding the occasion [The] hour - has come for you to wake up from [your] slumber for our - salvation [is] nearer now than when we {first} believed

verses.original: ἡ νὺξ προέκοψεν δὲ ἡ ἡμέρα ἤγγικεν οὖν ἀποθώμεθα τὰ ἔργα τοῦ σκότους δὲ ἐνδυσώμεθα τὰ ὅπλα τοῦ φωτός
verses.transliteration: hē nyx proekopsen de hē hēmera ēngiken oun apothōmetha ta erga tou skotous de endysōmetha ta hopla tou phōtos
verses.literal: The night is nearly over - the day has drawn near So let us lay aside the deeds - of darkness and put on the armor - of light

verses.original: περιπατήσωμεν εὐσχημόνως ὡς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μὴ κώμοις καὶ μέθαις μὴ κοίταις καὶ ἀσελγείαις μὴ ἔριδι καὶ ζήλῳ
verses.transliteration: peripatēsōmen euschēmonōs hōs en hēmera mē kōmois kai methais mē koitais kai aselgeiais mē eridi kai zēlō
verses.literal: Let us behave decently as in [the] daytime not in carousing and drunkenness not in sexual immorality and debauchery not in dissension and jealousy

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἐνδύσασθε τὸν Κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν καὶ ποιεῖσθε μὴ πρόνοιαν εἰς ἐπιθυμίας τῆς σαρκὸς
verses.transliteration: alla endysasthe ton Kyrion Iēsoun Christon kai poieisthe mē pronoian eis epithymias tēs sarkos
verses.literal: Instead clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ and make no provision for [the] desires of the flesh
